Find information about tuition fees, payment methods, and the conditions for fee waivers or refunds.
National fees
Tuition fees for national degrees are set by ministerial decree.
For the 2025–2026 academic year, tuition fees are set as follows (2026-2027 fees coming soon):
Bachelor level
Master level
Doctoral level

Please note that the amount of tuition fees may vary depending on the level and the number of degrees you are studying for (Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD). The rates apply:
the full rate for your first course if you enrol on a single programme;
a reduced rate for additional courses if you enrol on more than one programme at the same institution.

2025-2026 fees coming soon
‘Differentiated tuition fees’ for non-EU students
Université Paris-Saclay develops a strong policy of attracting national, European and international students. As part of this policy, non-EU students who are subject to differentiated fees are eligible for a partial exemption, which brings the differentiated registration fees in line with the fees applicable to domestic students, in accordance with the conditions laid down by the Board of Governors Resolution No. CA-2026-013 of 3 February 2026.
Payment by instalments
You can pay your registration fees in three instalments at no extra cost, online and by credit card only.
Exemption
You may be exempted, either fully or partially, from paying tuition fees:
automatically, if you are entitled to a statutory exemption (for example, if you receive a need-based grant or an annual specific financial support allowance), or
on the basis of criteria related to your individual circumstances and determined by the institution.
The 2025–2026 fee waiver procedure is now closed. Information regarding the 2026–2027 procedure will be published shortly.
Refund of tuition fees
You may apply for a refund of tuition fees in the following cases:
cancellation of your enrolment;
fee waiver granted after payment or overpayment of fees.
Refunds are subject to the conditions laid down by national regulations and by the institution’s rules and deadlines (see Board of Governors Resolution No. CA-2025-040 of 8 July 2025 - in french only).
The 2025–2026 refund procedure is now closed.
